mode.description: 'categorise': items are sorted into labelled category zones. 'label_image': items are labels that students drop onto points of the slide's image (the image is required).

instructions.description: One sentence telling the student what to drag where.

label.description: Category / drop-zone label (max ~30 characters). In label_image mode it is hidden from students.

x.description: Horizontal position in percent of the image width (0 = left edge, 100 = right edge).

y.description: Vertical position in percent of the image height (0 = top edge, 100 = bottom edge).

position.description: label_image mode: the point on the image where the centre of this drop zone goes. categorise mode: null.

zones.description: categorise: 2-4 drop zones (categories). label_image: 3-6 drop zones, one per point to label.

text.description: Text on the draggable card (max ~40 characters; max ~26 in label_image mode).

correct_zone.description: Label of the zone this item belongs to - must exactly match one zone label.

items.description: categorise: 2-8 draggable items; every zone must receive at least one item. label_image: exactly one item per zone.

text.description: One sentence (plain text) with ___ (three underscores) at each gap, e.g. 'When the depth of cut increases, the cutting ratio ___.' 1-2 gaps. No asterisks.

answer.description: The answer the student types: 1-3 words or a number, written exactly as in "options". Only letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, decimal points, commas and % (no symbols, subscripts, Greek letters or formulas).

options.description: 2-4 choices shown in bold brackets before the gap, e.g. ["increases", "decreases", "stays the same"]. Contains the answer exactly once; the others are plausible wrong answers of the same kind. Only letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, decimal points, commas and % (no symbols, subscripts, Greek letters or formulas).

blanks.description: One entry per ___ gap, in the order the gaps appear in the sentence.
